data.text: Research tasks KAD-1, KAD-2, KAD-4 and KAD-11 carry the engineering default criteria (tests first, npm test green, typecheck, timing). None of them can be checked on a recruiting or interview task, so the rule 'every criterion checked before it moves' cannot be honoured and the real ACs from plan-to-1.0 T50/T51 are not on the task at all. The default criteria should not be applied to a non-code task, or the task should take its own.
